messages:
Maria: quick pass on the metrics legend accessibility — found a few small but actionable issues with focus, SR announcements, and contrast.

Alex: can you drop repro steps? mobile affected too?

Maria: repro: open dashboard -> Tab into chart legend (right side) -> legend items are not tabbable individually; focus lands on the whole container. tooltip uses title attr so screen reader doesn't announce the extra context. also the tiny color swatches have very low contrast on dark theme.

Jamie: summary: keyboard nav should expose each legend item (so it can be focused), tooltip needs aria-describedby or aria-labelledby, and swatch needs a stronger border or hover/focus indicator.

Sam: agree. Two questions: 1) will making each item focusable break virtualization (they get recreated)? 2) any perf concerns for adding aria ids?

Maria: good call on virtualization — we'll need stable ids (data-legend-key) so aria-describedby points to a persistent node. for perf, it's just attributes — negligible.

Jamie: possible implementation: use button semantics so items are reachable and actionable (role="button" + tabindex="0"), and link aria-describedby to a tooltip element rendered in a live region when visible.

aria-audit-bot: Contrast scan: .legend-swatch small square on dark theme = 2.8:1 (fail for small UI elements). text label (#9DA3B0 on #0B1220) = 3.4:1 (borderline for 12px). Recommendation: bump label to #C7CEDA or increase font weight; add 1px stroke to swatches.

Maria: CSS suggestion (quick paste):
```css
.legend-item { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.legend-item[role=\"button\"]:focus { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-strong); outline-offset: 3px; }
.legend-swatch { width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 2px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.6); }
```

Alex: nice — QA: if we switch to aria-labelledby how do we keep labels unique?

Jamie: use a deterministic id pattern `legend-${chartId}-${seriesKey}` or attach a stable data attribute and compute id at render. also add an automated a11y test asserting `tabindex` present and `aria-describedby` id exists.

Sam: i'll spin up a PR with the button role, stable ids, and a tiny unit test simulating keyboard tab. also will swap the swatch border token to `neutral-300` to meet contrast.

Maria: :thumbsup: i'll prototype VoiceOver notes and attach a short screen recording.

Alex: plan — merge small a11y PR, run cross-platform SR check (macOS VoiceOver, NVDA, TalkBack), then close. Jamie can you add this to the console-a11y checklist?

Jamie: added as CA11Y-237, assigned to Maria + Sam, ETA Thu.

Maria: thanks all — uploading markup snippet and recording to the thread now.
